compensation.S4_no_go: observed top-20 motif concentration <= 95th percentile of null distribution
compensation.null: for each aliased source, retain its canonical target age and draw one target uniformly from 729 states at that age
compensation.tie_sensitivity: Phase 5 repeats motif analysis over co-nearest alternatives; canonical Phase-4 result uses locked smallest-index tie break
compensation.vector: xi_canonical_target - xi_source in locked factor order

conventional_benchmark.S5_downgrade: PWV-only pair-alias Jaccard with P0-reference >=0.90 AND subject-level alias-existence agreement >=0.95
conventional_benchmark.composite_alias_rule: PWV relative difference <=0.05 AND AIx absolute difference <=5 percentage points AND brachial SBP absolute difference <=5 mmHg

falsification_operationalization.S1: NO_GO_MAJOR_ALIASING_CLAIM if alias fraction <0.01 at every one of 24 P0 tolerance-grid points
falsification_operationalization.S2: NO_GO_ROBUST_ALIASING_CLAIM in Phase 5 if both L1-pressure and Linf-pressure subject-alias sets have Jaccard <0.50 versus P0 reference under same 5 mmHg/10 ms scales
falsification_operationalization.S3: NO_GO_PHYSIOLOGICAL_ALIASING_CLAIM if P0 reference alias fraction <0.01 AND is <20% of morphology-only (pressure RMSE<=5 mmHg) alias fraction
falsification_operationalization.S4: observed top-20 compensation-motif concentration <=95th percentile of locked permutation null
falsification_operationalization.S5: DOWNGRADE_NOVELTY if PWV-only pair-alias Jaccard>=0.90 AND subject-level alias-existence agreement>=0.95
falsification_operationalization.S6: NO_GO_MEASUREMENT_RESCUE_CLAIM if every M1-M4 reference rescue fraction <0.10
falsification_operationalization.S7: any need for forbidden subject-specific primary normalization invalidates primary claim

information_geometry.interpretation: local information/pullback metric; Fisher interpretation only under corresponding isotropic Gaussian measurement model

measurement_rescue.added_pressure_rule: pressure_rmse_at_site <= eP; duration is not re-counted because P0 already enforces duration
measurement_rescue.computational_rule: evaluate each richer arm only among P0-reference pair aliases surviving the preceding nested arm
measurement_rescue.semantics: all rescue arms augment P0 and are strictly nested; a source subject is rescued when it has >=1 P0 reference alias but zero aliases under the richer arm

numerics.numerical_audit: float64 arithmetic recomputation for deterministic 60-subject sample (10/age) plus every source with abs(D_ref-1)<=0.01; disagreement >1e-4 in D_ref or changed alias classification is a STOP until explained

phase4_execution_guard.required_phase3_commit_relation: Phase 4 must execute code/config unchanged from merged Phase-3 tree; Phase-4 notebook may only orchestrate execution and persist outputs.

primary.canonical_tie_break: smallest global target row index within min_distance + tie_atol
primary.pair_enumeration: all 15 unordered age-pair Cartesian products; 7,971,615 unordered cross-age pairs

waveform_representation.active_samples: values where neither VascuQuest missing_mask nor padding_mask is true
